# Match Point Pickleball Club

> The world's largest indoor pickleball destination — 38 courts in Columbus, Ohio. Memberships, leagues, lessons, table tennis, badminton, and Trackman golf.

Match Point Pickleball Club is located at 350 McCormick Blvd, Columbus, OH. Contact: 614-569-2556 / support@matchpointpickleballclub.com.
